question: ______ is a group of cells similar in structure and function.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tissue**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tissue**

 
 
• **​Tissue** is a group of cells similar in structure and function.
 
• A **biological **organisational level between cells and an entire organ, **tissue **is historically derived.
 
• Hence, a tissue is frequently considered to be an amalgamation of comparable cells and their extracellular matrix from the same origin that work together to perform a certain **function**.
 
• Afterwards, various tissues are functionally grouped together to form **organs**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Organ system**

 
 
• ​A group of **organs** that cooperate to carry out one or more functions is known as an **organ system i**n biology.
 
• Each organ in a plant or animal body is composed of certain **tissues** and serves a specific purpose.
 
 
 
• **Organ**
 
 
• ​**Organs** are groups of **tissues** that serve the same purpose. The brain, heart, kidneys, liver, and lungs are the five main organs that humans need to survive. Organs with similar functions frequently work together to create whole **organ systems**.
 
• **Parenchyma** and stroma make up an organ. The primary tissue that is peculiar to an organ, such as the myocardium, the primary tissue of the heart, is known as the **parenchyma**. **Nerves, blood vessels**, and **connective tissues** can all be found in the stroma, which is **sporadic tissue.**
 
 
 
• **Molecule**
 
 
• ​According to the context, the term may or may not include ions that meet this requirement. A **molecule** is a collection of two or more atoms held together by attractive forces known as **chemical bonds.**
 
• When speaking of **polyatomic** **ions**, the distinction between them and ions is frequently ignored in the fields of quantum physics, organic chemistry, and biochemistry.
